shortDescription: An earthquake measuring 5.8 magnitude struck Indonesia's Minahasa on Monday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre said.The quake hit at a depth of 184 km (114.33 miles), according to EMSC.

children: An earthquake measuring 5.8 magnitude struck Indonesia's Minahasa on Monday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre said.
The quake hit at a depth of 184 km (114.33 miles), according to EMSC.
